verdict.rationale: Stripe's docs publish a headline coverage figure: users can search "more than 12,000 supported banks." The pack has no first-party documentation of supported geographies or a checkable institution list. Only community comments say the product supports US banks only, which is consistent with the docs rather than contradicting them. Missing for 10: first-party published geography/country coverage, a searchable or downloadable institution list to check against users' banks, and connection-type or reliability breakdowns by institution.
